rows.en: Practice cards
rows.ne: अभ्यास कार्डहरू

rows.en: Examples of what people may say and what you can do, step by step. They take place in a private conversation, not in front of the group. The words are an illustration: use your own, follow the person’s lead, and use page 2 at once if there is any urgent sign.
rows.ne: मानिसहरूले के भन्न सक्छन् र तपाईं चरणबद्ध रूपमा के गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ भन्ने उदाहरणहरू । यी कुराकानी समूहका अगाडि होइन, निजी रूपमा हुन्छन् । शब्दहरू उदाहरण मात्र हुन्: आफ्नै शब्द प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, व्यक्तिको इच्छाअनुसार अघि बढ्नुहोस्, र कुनै तत्काल संकेत देखिएमा तुरुन्तै पृष्ठ २ प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Words for you to say or ask
rows.ne: तपाईंले भन्ने वा सोध्ने शब्दहरू

rows.en: What the person may say
rows.ne: व्यक्तिले भन्न सक्ने कुरा

rows.en: Guidance for you (plain text)
rows.ne: तपाईंका लागि निर्देशन (सादा अक्षर)

rows.en: WHEN A RELATIVE IS MISSING
rows.ne: आफन्त बेपत्ता हुँदा

rows.en: “My son is still missing. People say he is gone, but I know he will come back.”
rows.ne: “मेरो छोरा अझै बेपत्ता छ । मानिसहरू ऊ गइसक्यो भन्छन्, तर मलाई थाहा छ ऊ फर्केर आउँछ ।”

rows.en: Poster and leaflet: when a loved one is missing, hope and grief can be felt at the same time.
rows.ne: पोस्टर र पर्चा: प्रिय व्यक्ति बेपत्ता हुँदा आशा र शोक एकै समयमा महसुस हुन सक्छन् ।

rows.en: Listen without taking a side
rows.ne: कुनै पक्ष नलिई सुन्नुहोस्

rows.en: Do not agree or disagree about whether he has died. Never presume death, and do not talk about “closure”.
rows.ne: उनको मृत्यु भयो कि भएन भन्नेमा सहमति वा असहमति नजनाउनुहोस् । कहिल्यै मृत्यु भइसकेको नमान्नुहोस्, र “टुङ्गो” बारे कुरा नगर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Name what they may feel
rows.ne: उहाँले के महसुस गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ भनेर नाम दिनुहोस्

rows.en: “When someone is missing, hope and grief can be felt at the same time. Both are natural.”
rows.ne: “कोही बेपत्ता हुँदा आशा र शोक एकै समयमा महसुस हुन सक्छन् । दुवै स्वाभाविक हुन् ।”

rows.en: Link to verified information
rows.ne: पुष्टि गरिएको जानकारीसँग जोड्नुहोस्

rows.en: Give the verified tracing contact. Never promise an answer or a date.
rows.ne: पुष्टि गरिएको खोजी सम्पर्क दिनुहोस् । उत्तर वा मिति कहिल्यै वाचा नगर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Ask about today
rows.ne: आजको बारेमा सोध्नुहोस्

rows.en: “What would help you today while you wait?”
rows.ne: “पर्खिँदै गर्दा आज तपाईंलाई केले सहयोग गर्छ?”

rows.en: WHEN SOMEONE WORRIES ABOUT HOW THEY GRIEVE
rows.ne: कोही आफ्नो शोक गर्ने तरिकाबारे चिन्तित हुँदा

rows.en: “I have not cried once. Maybe something is wrong with me.”
rows.ne: “म एक पटक पनि रोएकी छैन । मलाई केही समस्या छ कि?”

rows.en: Poster: there is no right way to grieve.
rows.ne: पोस्टर: शोक गर्ने कुनै एउटै सही तरिका हुँदैन ।

rows.en: Name the variety of grief
rows.ne: शोक फरक-फरक हुन्छ भनेर बताउनुहोस्

rows.en: “There is no right way to grieve. People grieve in different ways, and there is no set time.”
rows.ne: “शोक गर्ने कुनै एउटै सही तरिका हुँदैन । मानिसहरू फरक-फरक तरिकाले शोक गर्छन्, र यसको कुनै तोकिएको समय हुँदैन ।”

rows.en: Invite, do not push
rows.ne: आमन्त्रण गर्नुहोस्, दबाब नदिनुहोस्

rows.en: “Would you like to tell me a little about how you have been remembering her, in your own way?”
rows.ne: “तपाईंले उहाँलाई आफ्नै तरिकाले कसरी सम्झिरहनुभएको छ, अलिकति बताउन चाहनुहुन्छ?”

rows.en: Accept a “no”. Do not prescribe crying, rites, prayer or talking.
rows.ne: “होइन” लाई स्वीकार गर्नुहोस् । रुन, विधि गर्न, प्रार्थना गर्न वा कुरा गर्न नतोक्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Keep the route to help open
rows.ne: सहयोगको बाटो खुला राख्नुहोस्

rows.en: Offer a health worker if grief makes it very hard to eat, sleep or care for themselves or others, or if they want support at any time.
rows.ne: शोकका कारण खान, सुत्न वा आफ्नो वा अरूको हेरचाह गर्न धेरै गाह्रो भएमा, वा उहाँ जुनसुकै बेला सहयोग चाहनुहुन्छ भने स्वास्थ्यकर्मीको प्रस्ताव गर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: WHEN A NEIGHBOUR ASKS HOW TO HELP
rows.ne: छिमेकीले कसरी सहयोग गर्ने भनेर सोध्दा

rows.en: “I do not know what to say to her. I am afraid of saying the wrong thing.”
rows.ne: “उहाँलाई के भन्ने मलाई थाहा छैन । गलत कुरा भनिहाल्छु कि भनेर डर लाग्छ ।”

rows.en: Poster: being there for someone who is grieving.
rows.ne: पोस्टर: शोकमा परेको व्यक्तिको साथ दिने ।

rows.en: Reassure the helper
rows.ne: सहयोग गर्न चाहने व्यक्तिलाई ढुक्क पार्नुहोस्

rows.en: “You do not need special words. You can stay close, listen, or simply sit quietly with her.”
rows.ne: “विशेष शब्द चाहिँदैन । तपाईं नजिकै बस्न, सुन्न, वा चुपचाप उहाँसँगै बस्न सक्नुहुन्छ ।”

rows.en: Suggest practical help
rows.ne: व्यावहारिक सहयोगको सुझाव दिनुहोस्

rows.en: Ask her what would help today, for example bringing food, collecting water or helping with a daily task, if she wants it.
rows.ne: उहाँ चाहनुहुन्छ भने आज केले सहयोग गर्छ भनेर सोध्नुहोस्, जस्तै खाना ल्याइदिने, पानी भरिदिने वा दैनिक काममा सघाउने ।

rows.en: Name what to avoid
rows.ne: के नगर्ने भनेर बताउनुहोस्

rows.en: Avoid saying “be strong”, comparing losses, or telling her when she should feel better.
rows.ne: “बलियो बन्नुहोस्” भन्न, क्षतिहरूको तुलना गर्न, वा उहाँलाई कहिले ठीक महसुस हुनुपर्छ भनेर भन्न छाड्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Know where help is
rows.ne: सहयोग कहाँ छ भनेर जान्नुहोस्

rows.en: Tell the neighbour where help is. If they are worried about her safety, use page 2.
rows.ne: छिमेकीलाई सहयोग कहाँ छ भनेर बताउनुहोस् । उहाँ ती महिलाको सुरक्षाबारे चिन्तित हुनुहुन्छ भने पृष्ठ २ प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Health Talk Guide · A4 · Chapter 3 of 6 · For people trained in psychological first aid, with a supervisor and known referral routes · English review draft · Not for field distribution.
rows.ne: स्वास्थ्य कुराकानी निर्देशिका · A4 · अध्याय ६ मध्ये ३ · मनोवैज्ञानिक प्राथमिक उपचारको तालिम लिएका, सुपरिवेक्षक भएका र प्रेषणको बाटो थाहा भएका व्यक्तिहरूका लागि · नेपाली मस्यौदा, मातृभाषी समीक्षा बाँकी · क्षेत्रमा वितरणका लागि होइन ।

ch4.title: Chapter 4 · Children react too · Poster A3
ch4.source: Approved English posters (options A, B and C as shown on this site) · Nepali machine draft r1 of 13 Nov 2026 (poster message bank), language and MHPSS review pending; every row needs a native reviewer

rows.en: AFTER A DISTRESSING EXPERIENCE
rows.ne: पीडादायी अनुभवपछि
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): After a distressing/painful experience.

rows.en: Children react too and families can help them feel safe
rows.ne: बालबालिकामा पनि प्रतिक्रिया देखिन्छ र परिवारले उनीहरूलाई सुरक्षित महसुस गराउन सक्छ
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Children also show reactions and families can help them feel safe.

rows.en: Changes in children are common after a distressing experience.
rows.ne: पीडादायी अनुभवपछि बालबालिकामा परिवर्तन देखिनु सामान्य हो ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): After a distressing experience it is common to see changes in children.

rows.en: Children may…
rows.ne: बालबालिकामा यस्तो देखिन सक्छ…

rows.en: Cling to you · Sleep badly · Cry or get angry more · Become very quiet
rows.ne: तपाईंसँग टाँसिइरहने · राम्रोसँग नसुत्ने · धेरै रुने वा रिसाउने · एकदमै चुपचाप हुने

rows.en: Cling to you
rows.ne: तपाईंसँग टाँसिइरहने

rows.en: Sleep badly
rows.ne: राम्रोसँग नसुत्ने

rows.en: Cry or get angry more
rows.ne: धेरै रुने वा रिसाउने

rows.en: Become very quiet
rows.ne: एकदमै चुपचाप हुने

rows.en: Do not punish a child for being afraid or upset.
rows.ne: डराएकोमा वा दुःखी भएकोमा बच्चालाई सजाय नदिनुहोस् ।

rows.en: What helps
rows.ne: केले सहयोग गर्छ

rows.en: Stay close
rows.ne: नजिकै रहनुहोस्

rows.en: Keep daily routines
rows.ne: दैनिक दिनचर्या कायम राख्नुहोस्

rows.en: Answer questions honestly, in simple words
rows.ne: प्रश्नको इमानदारीपूर्वक, सरल शब्दमा जवाफ दिनुहोस्

rows.en: Make time for safe play
rows.ne: सुरक्षित खेलका लागि समय दिनुहोस्

rows.en: Ask for help early
rows.ne: समयमै सहयोग माग्नुहोस्
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Ask for help in time.

rows.en: Get help now
rows.ne: अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस्
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Get help right now.

rows.en: Changes in your child getting worse, not going away, or making daily life hard? Talk to a health worker. You do not have to wait.
rows.ne: के तपाईंको बच्चामा देखिएका परिवर्तन झन् बढ्दैछन्, हटिरहेका छैनन्, वा दैनिक जीवन कठिन बनाइरहेका छन्? स्वास्थ्यकर्मीसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस् । तपाईंले पर्खनुपर्दैन ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Are changes seen in your child increasing, not going away, or making daily life difficult? Talk to a health worker. You do not have to wait.

rows.en: In danger, or thinking of harming yourself? Get help now. Ask a health worker or responder, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.
rows.ne: के तपाईं खतरामा हुनुहुन्छ, वा आफूलाई हानि पुर्‍याउने सोच आइरहेको छ? अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस् । स्वास्थ्यकर्मी वा उद्धारकर्मीलाई सहयोग माग्नुहोस्, र आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिसलाई तपाईंसँगै बस्न भन्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Are you in danger, or having thoughts of harming yourself? Get help right now. Ask a health worker or rescue worker for help, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.

rows.en: Help near you: ____________ (filled in and checked locally)
rows.ne: तपाईं नजिकैको सहयोग: ____________ (स्थानीय रूपमा भरेर जाँच गरिएको)
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Help near you: ____________ (filled and checked locally).

rows.en: Look after yourself. Look after each other.
rows.ne: आफ्नो ख्याल राख्नुहोस् । एकअर्काको ख्याल राख्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Support is for everyone, including people with disabilities and older people. Ask for large print or more time.
rows.ne: सहयोग सबैका लागि हो, अपाङ्गता भएका व्यक्ति र ज्येष्ठ नागरिकका लागि पनि । ठूला अक्षर वा थप समय माग्न सक्नुहुन्छ ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Support is for everyone, including persons with disabilities and older citizens. You may ask for large letters or more time.

rows.en: Community wall poster · A3 · Chapter 4 of 6 · English review draft · Not for field distribution.
rows.ne: सामुदायिक भित्ते पोस्टर · A3 · अध्याय ६ मध्ये ४ · नेपाली समीक्षा मस्यौदा · क्षेत्रमा वितरणका लागि होइन ।

rows.en: Fictional illustrations, AI-assisted and developed under human direction.
rows.ne: काल्पनिक चित्रहरू, मानवीय निर्देशनमा AI को सहायताले तयार गरिएका ।

ch4.title: Chapter 4 · Children react too · Leaflet A4 tri-fold
ch4.source: Approved English leaflet r4 (exact text of the online and print versions) · Nepali machine draft r2, 14 Nov 2026, language and MHPSS review pending; every row needs a native reviewer

rows.en: AFTER A DISTRESSING EXPERIENCE
rows.ne: पीडादायी अनुभवपछि
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): After a distressing/painful experience.

rows.en: Children react too
rows.ne: बालबालिकामा पनि प्रतिक्रिया देखिन्छ
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Children feel a distressing experience too, even when they do not talk about it. Changes in how they behave are common afterwards. Your love and attention help them feel safe.
rows.ne: बालबालिकाले कुरा नगरे पनि पीडादायी अनुभवको असर उनीहरूमा पनि पर्छ । त्यसपछि उनीहरूको व्यवहारमा परिवर्तन आउनु सामान्य हो । तपाईंको माया र ध्यानले उनीहरूलाई सुरक्षित महसुस गराउँछ ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Even if children do not talk, a distressing experience affects them too. Afterwards, change in their behaviour is common. Your love and attention make them feel safe.

rows.en: What helps
rows.ne: केले सहयोग गर्छ
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): None

rows.en: Stay close
rows.ne: नजिकै रहनुहोस्
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): None

rows.en: Keep children with their family whenever possible. If you must be apart, tell them when you will be back.
rows.ne: सम्भव भएसम्म बालबालिकालाई परिवारसँगै राख्नुहोस् । छुट्टिनै पर्ने भए, कहिले फर्कनुहुन्छ भनेर उनीहरूलाई बताउनुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Explain simply
rows.ne: सरल रूपमा बताउनुहोस्
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Tell them what happened and what is happening now, in words they understand. It is all right to say “I don’t know yet”.
rows.ne: के भयो र अहिले के भइरहेको छ, उनीहरूले बुझ्ने शब्दमा बताउनुहोस् । "मलाई अझै थाहा छैन" भन्नु पनि ठीकै हो ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Give extra time
rows.ne: थप समय दिनुहोस्
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Listen, speak kindly, and give more time and affection.
rows.ne: सुन्नुहोस्, मायालु तरिकाले बोल्नुहोस्, र थप समय र माया दिनुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Keep routines
rows.ne: दिनचर्या कायम राख्नुहोस्
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Regular times for meals, sleep and play, even in a new place. Make new routines if the old ones are not possible.
rows.ne: नयाँ ठाउँमा पनि खाना, निद्रा र खेलका लागि नियमित समय राख्नुहोस् । पुरानो दिनचर्या सम्भव नभए नयाँ दिनचर्या बनाउनुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Make time for safe play
rows.ne: सुरक्षित खेलका लागि समय दिनुहोस्
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): None

rows.en: Play, drawing and songs help children feel safer and express feelings.
rows.ne: खेल, चित्र कोर्ने र गीत गाउने कुराले बालबालिकालाई बढी सुरक्षित महसुस गर्न र आफ्ना भावना व्यक्त गर्न मद्दत गर्छ ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Talking about loss
rows.ne: क्षतिबारे कुरा गर्दा
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): When talking about loss

rows.en: If someone has died or is missing, answer questions honestly and simply. Children may ask the same question many times. Let them share memories, through drawing or stories, if they wish.
rows.ne: कसैको मृत्यु भएको वा कोही बेपत्ता भएको छ भने, उनीहरूका प्रश्नको इमानदारीपूर्वक र सरल जवाफ दिनुहोस् । बालबालिकाले एउटै प्रश्न धेरैपटक सोध्न सक्छन् । उनीहरू चाहन्छन् भने, चित्र कोरेर वा कथा सुनाएर सम्झना बाँड्न दिनुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): If someone has died or is missing, answer their questions honestly and simply. Children may ask the same question many times. If they want, let them share memories by drawing or telling stories.

rows.en: My Hero is You, a story book for children aged 6 to 11, is available in Nepali.
rows.ne: ६ देखि ११ वर्षका बालबालिकाका लागि कथा पुस्तक My Hero is You नेपालीमा पनि उपलब्ध छ ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Look after yourself too
rows.ne: आफ्नो पनि ख्याल राख्नुहोस्
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Caring for children after a distressing experience is hard. Take a short pause when you feel angry or tired: breathe, then respond. Ask family or neighbours to share care.
rows.ne: पीडादायी अनुभवपछि बालबालिकाको हेरचाह गर्नु गाह्रो हुन्छ । रिस उठेको वा थकाइ लागेको बेला एकछिन रोकिनुहोस्: सास फेर्नुहोस्, अनि मात्र प्रतिक्रिया दिनुहोस् । हेरचाहमा सघाउन परिवार वा छिमेकीलाई अनुरोध गर्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): After a distressing experience caring for children is hard. When angry or tired, pause a moment: breathe, then respond. Ask family or neighbours to help with care.

rows.en: Do not punish a child for being afraid, wetting the bed or behaving differently.
rows.ne: डराएकोमा, ओछ्यानमा पिसाब फेरेकोमा वा फरक व्यवहार गरेकोमा बच्चालाई सजाय नदिनुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Do not punish a child for being afraid, wetting the bed or behaving differently.

rows.en: Do not leave children alone with people you do not know.
rows.ne: बालबालिकालाई नचिनेका मानिससँग एक्लै नछोड्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Do not leave children alone with unknown people.

rows.en: When to ask for help
rows.ne: कहिले सहयोग माग्ने
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Talk to a health worker if changes in your child go on for a long time or get worse, if your child stops eating, playing or talking, or if your child talks about hurting themselves. If a child is alone, separated from their family, or at risk of harm, tell a responder or ____________ (child protection contact, filled in locally) straight away.
rows.ne: बच्चामा देखिएका परिवर्तन लामो समयसम्म रहिरहेमा वा झन् बढेमा, बच्चाले खान, खेल्न वा बोल्न छाडेमा, वा बच्चाले आफूलाई हानि पुर्‍याउने कुरा गरेमा स्वास्थ्यकर्मीसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस् । कुनै बच्चा एक्लै छ, परिवारबाट छुट्टिएको छ, वा हानिको जोखिममा छ भने तुरुन्तै उद्धारकर्मी वा ____________ (बाल संरक्षण सम्पर्क, स्थानीय रूपमा भरिने) लाई खबर गर्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Talk with a health worker if changes in the child stay a long time or grow worse, if the child stops eating, playing or speaking, or if the child talks of harming himself/herself. If a child is alone, separated from family, or at risk of harm, inform a responder or ____ (child protection contact, filled in locally) immediately.

rows.en: What you may notice
rows.ne: तपाईंले यस्तो देख्न सक्नुहुन्छ
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Young children
rows.ne: साना बालबालिका
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Clinging, crying more, wetting the bed again, trouble sleeping, or being afraid when you are out of sight
rows.ne: टाँसिइरहने, धेरै रुने, फेरि ओछ्यानमा पिसाब फेर्ने, निदाउन गाह्रो हुने, वा तपाईं नदेखिँदा डराउने
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Older children
rows.ne: अलि ठूला बालबालिका
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Being very quiet or very restless, getting angry easily, trouble concentrating, or playing out what happened again and again
rows.ne: एकदमै चुपचाप वा एकदमै चकचके हुने, सजिलै रिसाउने, ध्यान केन्द्रित गर्न गाह्रो हुने, वा भएको घटनालाई खेलमा बारम्बार दोहोर्‍याउने
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Being very quiet or very restless, getting angry easily, finding it hard to concentrate, or repeating what happened in play again and again

rows.en: Adolescents
rows.ne: किशोरकिशोरी
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Staying away from others, being irritable, worrying about the family, or taking risks
rows.ne: अरूबाट टाढा बस्ने, झर्को मान्ने, परिवारको चिन्ता गर्ने, वा जोखिमपूर्ण काम गर्ने
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Children with disabilities
rows.ne: अपाङ्गता भएका बालबालिका
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Children with disabilities may need more time, clear routines and your help to join play. For more, see the leaflet for parents of children and adolescents with disabilities (CMC-Nepal).
rows.ne: अपाङ्गता भएका बालबालिकालाई थप समय, स्पष्ट दिनचर्या र खेलमा सहभागी हुन तपाईंको सहयोग चाहिन सक्छ । थप जानकारीका लागि अपाङ्गता भएका बालबालिका र किशोरकिशोरीका अभिभावकका लागि सीएमसी-नेपालको पर्चा हेर्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Ask for help early
rows.ne: समयमै सहयोग माग्नुहोस्
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Ask for help in time.

rows.en: Changes in your child getting worse, not going away, or making daily life hard? Talk to a health worker. You do not have to wait.
rows.ne: के तपाईंको बच्चामा देखिएका परिवर्तन झन् बढ्दैछन्, हटिरहेका छैनन्, वा दैनिक जीवन कठिन बनाइरहेका छन्? स्वास्थ्यकर्मीसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस् । तपाईंले पर्खनुपर्दैन ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Are changes seen in your child increasing, not going away, or making daily life difficult? Talk to a health worker. You do not have to wait.

rows.en: Get help now
rows.ne: अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस्
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Get help right now.

rows.en: In danger, or thinking of harming yourself? Get help now. Ask a health worker or responder, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.
rows.ne: के तपाईं खतरामा हुनुहुन्छ, वा आफूलाई हानि पुर्‍याउने सोच आइरहेको छ? अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस् । स्वास्थ्यकर्मी वा उद्धारकर्मीलाई सहयोग माग्नुहोस्, र आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिसलाई तपाईंसँगै बस्न भन्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Are you in danger, or having thoughts of harming yourself? Get help right now. Ask a health worker or rescue worker for help, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.

rows.en: Help near you:
rows.ne: तपाईं नजिकैको सहयोग:
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Help near you:

rows.en: ____________ (filled in and checked locally)
rows.ne: ____________ (स्थानीय रूपमा भरेर जाँच गरिएको)
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): ____ (filled in and checked locally)

rows.en: Look after yourself. Look after each other.
rows.ne: आफ्नो ख्याल राख्नुहोस् । एकअर्काको ख्याल राख्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): None

rows.en: Support is for everyone, including people with disabilities and older people. Ask for large print or more time.
rows.ne: सहयोग सबैका लागि हो, अपाङ्गता भएका व्यक्ति र ज्येष्ठ नागरिकका लागि पनि । ठूला अक्षर वा थप समय माग्न सक्नुहुन्छ ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Support is for everyone, including persons with disabilities and older citizens. You may ask for large letters or more time.

rows.en: Sources: WHO and UNICEF, Helping children cope with stress (2020); WHO, UNICEF and partners, Parenting for Lifelong Health tips (2020); IASC, My Hero is You (2020); WHO, Psychological First Aid: Guide for Field Workers (2011); WHO/UNHCR, mhGAP Humanitarian Intervention Guide (2015). This material draws on these publications; it was not created by WHO, UNICEF or IASC, which are not responsible for its content.
rows.ne: स्रोतहरू: WHO and UNICEF, Helping children cope with stress (2020); WHO, UNICEF and partners, Parenting for Lifelong Health tips (2020); IASC, My Hero is You (2020); WHO, Psychological First Aid: Guide for Field Workers (2011); WHO/UNHCR, mhGAP Humanitarian Intervention Guide (2015) । यो सामग्री यी प्रकाशनहरूमा आधारित छ; यसलाई WHO, UNICEF वा IASC ले तयार पारेको होइन, र यसको विषयवस्तुप्रति उनीहरू जिम्मेवार छैनन् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Take-home leaflet · A4 · Chapter 4 of 6 · English review draft · Not for field distribution. Fictional illustrations, AI-assisted and developed under human direction.
rows.ne: घर लैजाने पर्चा · A4 · अध्याय ६ मध्ये ४ · नेपाली समीक्षा मस्यौदा · क्षेत्रमा वितरणका लागि होइन । काल्पनिक चित्रहरू, मानवीय निर्देशनमा AI को सहायताले तयार गरिएका ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Take-home leaflet · A4 · chapter 4 of 6 · Nepali review draft · not for field distribution. Fictional pictures, made with AI help under human direction.

ch4.title: Chapter 4 · Children react too · Health Talk Guide
ch4.source: Approved English Health Talk Guide v1 (exact text of the 5 pages) · Nepali machine draft v1 NE, 14 Nov 2026, language and MHPSS review pending; safety and clinical rows first. Rows that repeat on several pages appear once.

rows.en: HEALTH TALK GUIDE · CHAPTER 4 OF 6
rows.ne: स्वास्थ्य कुराकानी निर्देशिका · अध्याय ६ मध्ये ४

rows.en: Talking with caregivers: / Children react too
rows.ne: अभिभावकसँग कुराकानी: / बालबालिकामा पनि प्रतिक्रिया हुन्छ

rows.en: For people trained in psychological first aid, with a supervisor and known referral routes, including child protection.
rows.ne: मनोवैज्ञानिक प्राथमिक उपचार (PFA) को तालिम लिएका, सुपरिवेक्षक भएका र बाल संरक्षणसहित प्रेषणको बाटो थाहा भएका व्यक्तिहरूका लागि ।

rows.en: Before the talk, read the facilitator pages from page 3.
rows.ne: कुराकानी अघि पृष्ठ ३ देखिका सहजकर्ताका पृष्ठहरू पढ्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: Not visible in the current English or Nepali print PDF of Chapter 4: the page 1 header has no room for it. Please still check the Nepali; it returns in the next layout version.

rows.en: Immediate danger or a child at risk? Pause the session, stay with the person and get urgent help now. Stay until a health worker or responder takes over; feeling calmer is not the end point. Full procedure and contacts: page 2.
rows.ne: तत्काल खतरा छ वा कुनै बच्चा जोखिममा छ? सत्र रोक्नुहोस्, त्यो व्यक्तिसँगै बस्नुहोस् र अहिले नै तत्काल सहयोग लिनुहोस् । स्वास्थ्यकर्मी वा उद्धारकर्मीले जिम्मा नलिँदासम्म साथमै रहनुहोस्; अलि शान्त महसुस हुनु अन्तिम बिन्दु होइन । पूरा प्रक्रिया र सम्पर्क: पृष्ठ २ ।

rows.en: Poster A3
rows.ne: पोस्टर A3

rows.en: Leaflet, tri-fold
rows.ne: पर्चा, तीन पट्ट

rows.en: Your materials
rows.ne: तपाईंका सामग्रीहरू

rows.en: Poster · a shared focus
rows.ne: पोस्टर · सबैको साझा ध्यान

rows.en: For a group: open the discussion, invite observations and return to the main message. Make sure everyone can see; do not read every line aloud.
rows.ne: समूहका लागि: छलफल सुरु गर्न, मानिसहरूले देखेका कुरा सोध्न र मुख्य सन्देशमा फर्कन प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् । सबैले देख्न सक्ने बनाउनुहोस्; हरेक लाइन ठूलो स्वरमा नपढ्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Leaflet · detail to take home
rows.ne: पर्चा · घर लैजाने विस्तृत जानकारी

rows.en: For a question or a closer look, and to keep or share. Open only the relevant section, for example the reactions by age group, and offer to read it together.
rows.ne: कुनै प्रश्न आएमा वा नजिकबाट हेर्न, र आफूसँग राख्न वा अरूलाई दिन । सम्बन्धित भाग मात्र खोल्नुहोस्, जस्तै उमेर समूहअनुसारका प्रतिक्रिया, र सँगै पढ्ने प्रस्ताव गर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Use one or both, in any order. Focus on what caregivers need, not on finishing both materials.
rows.ne: एउटा वा दुवै सामग्री, जुनसुकै क्रममा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् । दुवै सामग्री सक्नेमा होइन, अभिभावकलाई के चाहिन्छ भन्नेमा ध्यान दिनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Before people arrive
rows.ne: मानिसहरू आउनुअघि

rows.en: Find out who the child protection focal point is in this area, and fill in and check the help contacts on page 2. Plan time after the session for private talks.
rows.ne: यस क्षेत्रको बाल संरक्षण सम्पर्क व्यक्ति को हुनुहुन्छ भनेर पत्ता लगाउनुहोस्, र पृष्ठ २ मा सहयोग सम्पर्कहरू भर्नुहोस् र जाँच्नुहोस् । सत्रपछि निजी कुराकानीका लागि समय छुट्याउनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Arrange safe play for children nearby, supervised by another adult, so that caregivers can join. Hang the poster where everyone can see it; bring enough leaflets.
rows.ne: अभिभावकहरू सहभागी हुन सकून् भनेर नजिकै अर्का वयस्कको निगरानीमा बालबालिकाका लागि सुरक्षित खेलको व्यवस्था गर्नुहोस् । सबैले देख्ने ठाउँमा पोस्टर टाँस्नुहोस्; पर्याप्त पर्चा ल्याउनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Plan language and access: simple words, large print, more time, or a sign language interpreter if needed and available. Invite caregivers of children with disabilities.
rows.ne: भाषा र पहुँचको योजना बनाउनुहोस्: सरल शब्द, ठूला अक्षर, थप समय, वा आवश्यक र उपलब्ध भए साङ्केतिक भाषा दोभाषे । अपाङ्गता भएका बालबालिकाका अभिभावकलाई पनि निम्तो दिनुहोस् ।

rows.en: The session
rows.ne: सत्र

rows.en: about 15 minutes · do not rush someone or delay urgent help to finish the plan
rows.ne: करिब १५ मिनेट · योजना पूरा गर्न कसैलाई हतार नगराउनुहोस्, तत्काल सहयोगमा ढिलाइ नगर्नुहोस्

rows.en: Aim: caregivers know that changes in children are common, choose one way to help this week, and know where to get help.
rows.ne: उद्देश्य: बालबालिकामा परिवर्तन आउनु सामान्य हो भनेर अभिभावकलाई थाहा होस्, यो हप्ता सहयोग गर्ने एउटा तरिका छानून्, र सहयोग कहाँ पाइन्छ थाहा होस् ।

rows.en: Welcome and explain the purpose
rows.ne: स्वागत र उद्देश्य बताउने

rows.en: 2 min · either material
rows.ne: २ मिनेट · कुनै पनि सामग्री

rows.en: DO
rows.ne: गर्नुहोस्

rows.en: Introduce yourself and the topic. Joining is voluntary. Say clearly that nobody has to talk about their own child in the group.
rows.ne: आफ्नो परिचय दिनुहोस् र विषय बताउनुहोस् । सहभागिता स्वैच्छिक हो । समूहमा कसैले आफ्नै बच्चाबारे कुरा गर्नुपर्दैन भनेर स्पष्ट भन्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: SAY
rows.ne: भन्नुहोस्

rows.en: “Today we will talk about how children react after a distressing experience, and the simple things families can do.”
rows.ne: “आज हामी पीडादायी अनुभवपछि बालबालिकामा कस्ता प्रतिक्रिया हुन्छन्, र परिवारले गर्न सक्ने सरल कुराहरूबारे कुरा गर्नेछौं ।”

rows.en: Look at the picture together
rows.ne: सँगै चित्र हेर्ने

rows.en: 3 min · poster if useful
rows.ne: ३ मिनेट · उपयोगी भए पोस्टर

rows.en: Point to the adults and children in the picture. Explain that clinging, crying, anger or being very quiet are common. With the leaflet only, use its cover.
rows.ne: चित्रका वयस्क र बालबालिकालाई देखाउनुहोस् । टाँसिइरहनु, रुनु, रिसाउनु वा धेरै चुप हुनु सामान्य हो भनेर बताउनुहोस् । पर्चा मात्र भए त्यसको आवरण प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: ASK
rows.ne: सोध्नुहोस्

rows.en: “What do you see the children doing?”
rows.ne: “बालबालिकाले के गरिरहेको देख्नुहुन्छ?”

rows.en: “These changes are common. They do not mean the child is bad or that you are a bad parent.”
rows.ne: “यी परिवर्तन सामान्य हुन् । यसको अर्थ बच्चा खराब छ वा तपाईं खराब अभिभावक हुनुहुन्छ भन्ने होइन ।”

rows.en: What helps
rows.ne: केले सहयोग गर्छ

rows.en: 5 min · move between materials as needed
rows.ne: ५ मिनेट · आवश्यकताअनुसार सामग्री बदल्दै

rows.en: Go through the four things in the picture, from staying close to answering questions honestly. Ask caregivers to choose one to try this week.
rows.ne: नजिकै रहनेदेखि प्रश्नको इमानदारीपूर्वक जवाफ दिनेसम्म, चित्रका चारवटा कुरा हेर्नुहोस् । यो हप्ता प्रयास गर्न एउटा छान्न अभिभावकलाई भन्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: “Children need adults’ love and attention during difficult times.”
rows.ne: “कठिन समयमा बालबालिकालाई वयस्कको माया र ध्यान चाहिन्छ ।”

rows.en: “What helps your children on a hard day?”
rows.ne: “गाह्रो दिनमा तपाईंका बालबालिकालाई केले सहयोग गर्छ?”

rows.en: When to ask for help
rows.ne: कहिले सहयोग माग्ने

rows.en: 3 min · relevant help section
rows.ne: ३ मिनेट · सम्बन्धित सहयोग भाग

rows.en: Point to the help messages. Say where the health worker and the child protection contact are; use page 2 if concern arises.
rows.ne: सहयोग सन्देशहरू देखाउनुहोस् । स्वास्थ्यकर्मी र बाल संरक्षण सम्पर्क कहाँ हुनुहुन्छ भनेर बताउनुहोस्; चिन्ताको कुरा आएमा पृष्ठ २ प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: “If a child here needs help, who would you go to?”
rows.ne: “यहाँ कुनै बच्चालाई सहयोग चाहिएमा तपाईं कसकहाँ जानुहुन्छ?”

rows.en: Check understanding and close
rows.ne: बुझाइ जाँच्ने र समापन

rows.en: 2 min · offer the leaflet to keep
rows.ne: २ मिनेट · राख्नका लागि पर्चा दिनुहोस्

rows.en: Give out the leaflet and show “What you may notice” and “When to ask for help”. Mention the Nepali story book My Hero is You (ages 6 to 11). Offer to talk privately after the session.
rows.ne: पर्चा दिनुहोस् र “तपाईंले देख्न सक्ने कुरा” र “कहिले सहयोग माग्ने” देखाउनुहोस् । नेपाली कथा पुस्तक My Hero is You (६ देखि ११ वर्ष) बारे बताउनुहोस् । सत्रपछि निजी रूपमा कुरा गर्ने प्रस्ताव गर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: “Which one thing will you try with your child this week?”
rows.ne: “यो हप्ता आफ्नो बच्चासँग तपाईं कुन एउटा कुरा प्रयास गर्नुहुन्छ?”

rows.en: Health Talk Guide · A4 · Chapter 4 of 6 · English review draft · Not for field distribution. Fictional illustrations, AI-assisted and developed under human direction.
rows.ne: स्वास्थ्य कुराकानी निर्देशिका · A4 · अध्याय ६ मध्ये ४ · नेपाली मस्यौदा, मातृभाषी समीक्षा बाँकी · क्षेत्रमा वितरणका लागि होइन । काल्पनिक चित्रहरू, मानव निर्देशनमा AI को सहायताले तयार गरिएका ।

rows.en: HEALTH TALK GUIDE · CHAPTER 4 OF 6 · KEEP WITHIN REACH
rows.ne: स्वास्थ्य कुराकानी निर्देशिका · अध्याय ६ मध्ये ४ · सधैं नजिकै राख्नुहोस्

rows.en: Safety, referral and worker boundaries
rows.ne: सुरक्षा, प्रेषण र कार्यकर्ताका सीमाहरू

rows.en: Get urgent help now if someone:
rows.ne: कसैमा यी कुरा देखिए अहिले नै तत्काल सहयोग लिनुहोस्:

rows.en: SIGNS
rows.ne: संकेतहरू

rows.en: Talks about suicide, or about harming themselves or someone else; this includes a child who talks about hurting themselves
rows.ne: आत्महत्याको, वा आफूलाई वा अरूलाई हानि पुर्‍याउने कुरा गर्छ; आफूलाई हानि पुर्‍याउने कुरा गर्ने बच्चा पनि यसमा पर्छ

rows.en: Cannot keep themselves safe, or cannot care for a child in their care
rows.ne: आफूलाई सुरक्षित राख्न सक्दैन, वा आफ्नो जिम्मामा रहेको बच्चाको हेरचाह गर्न सक्दैन

rows.en: Seems very confused, or not aware of where they are
rows.ne: धेरै अलमलमा परेको देखिन्छ, वा आफू कहाँ छ भन्ने थाहा पाउँदैन

rows.en: A child is alone or separated from their family
rows.ne: कुनै बच्चा एक्लै छ वा परिवारबाट छुट्टिएको छ

rows.en: WHAT TO DO
rows.ne: के गर्ने

rows.en: Stay with the person. Do not leave them alone.
rows.ne: त्यो व्यक्तिसँगै बस्नुहोस् । उहाँलाई एक्लै नछोड्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Get urgent help now: a health worker, responder or the emergency service in this area.
rows.ne: अहिले नै तत्काल सहयोग लिनुहोस्: यस क्षेत्रका स्वास्थ्यकर्मी, उद्धारकर्मी वा आपतकालीन सेवा ।

rows.en: It is okay to ask directly about suicide. Asking does not put the idea in their mind.
rows.ne: आत्महत्याबारे सिधै सोध्नु ठीक हो । सोध्दैमा उहाँको मनमा त्यो विचार आउँदैन ।

rows.en: Stay until a health worker or responder takes over. Feeling calmer is not the end point.
rows.ne: स्वास्थ्यकर्मी वा उद्धारकर्मीले जिम्मा नलिँदासम्म साथमै रहनुहोस् । अलि शान्त महसुस हुनु अन्तिम बिन्दु होइन ।

rows.en: A child may be at risk of abuse or neglect: follow your child safeguarding procedure and contact the child protection focal point. Do not investigate yourself.
rows.ne: कुनै बच्चा दुर्व्यवहार वा बेवास्ताको जोखिममा हुन सक्छ: आफ्नो बाल सुरक्षा (safeguarding) प्रक्रिया पालना गर्नुहोस् र बाल संरक्षण सम्पर्क व्यक्तिलाई सम्पर्क गर्नुहोस् । आफैं अनुसन्धान नगर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: If someone becomes upset
rows.ne: कोही विचलित भएमा

rows.en: Stay calm and stay close.
rows.ne: शान्त रहनुहोस् र नजिकै बस्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Offer a quieter place away from the group, if they wish.
rows.ne: उहाँ चाहनुहुन्छ भने समूहबाट टाढा अलि शान्त ठाउँ दिनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Do not force them to talk. Ask what they need now.
rows.ne: बोल्न कर नगर्नुहोस् । अहिले उहाँलाई के चाहिन्छ भनेर सोध्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Stay as long as they want, or until someone they trust is with them.
rows.ne: उहाँ चाहनुभएसम्म, वा उहाँले विश्वास गर्ने कोही साथमा नआएसम्म बस्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: PFA: Look, Listen and Link
rows.ne: PFA: हेर्ने, सुन्ने र जोड्ने

rows.en: Look: safety, urgent needs, people who are very distressed
rows.ne: हेर्ने: सुरक्षा, तत्काल आवश्यकता, अत्यन्त विचलित मानिसहरू

rows.en: Listen: ask about needs and concerns; help them feel calm
rows.ne: सुन्ने: आवश्यकता र चिन्ताबारे सोध्ने; शान्त हुन सहयोग गर्ने

rows.en: Link: basic needs, services, information, loved ones
rows.ne: जोड्ने: आधारभूत आवश्यकता, सेवा, जानकारी, आफन्त

rows.en: Talk privately and link to further help if
rows.ne: यस्तो भएमा निजी रूपमा कुरा गर्नुहोस् र थप सहयोगसँग जोड्नुहोस्

rows.en: Changes in a child go on for a long time or get worse
rows.ne: बच्चामा देखिएका परिवर्तन लामो समयसम्म रहन्छन् वा झन् बढ्छन्

rows.en: A child stops eating, playing or talking
rows.ne: बच्चाले खान, खेल्न वा बोल्न छाड्छ

rows.en: A caregiver says they cannot cope, or is afraid of hurting the child
rows.ne: अभिभावक आफूले सम्हाल्न नसकेको, वा बच्चालाई हानि पुर्‍याइहाल्छु कि भन्ने डर भएको बताउनुहुन्छ

rows.en: With the person's agreement: explain the options, go with them if you can, and share only what is needed.
rows.ne: उहाँको सहमतिमा: विकल्पहरू बताउनुहोस्, सकेमा साथै जानुहोस्, र आवश्यक कुरा मात्र अरूलाई बताउनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Do
rows.ne: गर्नुहोस्

rows.en: Speak to caregivers with respect; they know their children best
rows.ne: अभिभावकसँग सम्मानपूर्वक कुरा गर्नुहोस्; आफ्ना बालबालिकालाई उहाँहरू नै राम्रोसँग चिन्नुहुन्छ

rows.en: Give examples for different ages
rows.ne: फरक-फरक उमेरका उदाहरण दिनुहोस्

rows.en: Include caregivers of children with disabilities
rows.ne: अपाङ्गता भएका बालबालिकाका अभिभावकलाई समावेश गर्नुहोस्

rows.en: Follow up privately with anyone who asks
rows.ne: सोध्ने जोकोहीसँग पछि निजी रूपमा कुरा गर्नुहोस्

rows.en: Do not
rows.ne: नगर्नुहोस्

rows.en: Blame parents for their children’s reactions
rows.ne: बालबालिकाका प्रतिक्रियाका लागि अभिभावकलाई दोष नदिनुहोस्

rows.en: Ask about a child’s experiences in front of the group
rows.ne: समूहका अगाडि कुनै बच्चाका अनुभवबारे नसोध्नुहोस्

rows.en: Promise schooling, support or services you cannot confirm
rows.ne: पुष्टि गर्न नसकिने विद्यालय, सहयोग वा सेवाको वाचा नगर्नुहोस्

rows.en: Help contacts for this area
rows.ne: यस क्षेत्रका सहयोग सम्पर्कहरू

rows.en: fill in and check before the talk
rows.ne: कुराकानी अघि भर्नुहोस् र जाँच्नुहोस्

rows.en: Health worker or facility
rows.ne: स्वास्थ्यकर्मी वा स्वास्थ्य संस्था

rows.en: Urgent help
rows.ne: तत्काल सहयोग

rows.en: Child protection focal point
rows.ne: बाल संरक्षण सम्पर्क व्यक्ति

rows.en: Other support
rows.ne: अन्य सहयोग

rows.en: Sources: WHO, Psychological First Aid: Guide for Field Workers (2011); WHO and UNICEF, Helping children cope with stress (2020); WHO, UNICEF and partners, Parenting for Lifelong Health tips (2020); IASC, Guidelines on MHPSS in Emergency Settings (2007); WHO/UNHCR, mhGAP Humanitarian Intervention Guide (2015). rows.en: HEALTH TALK GUIDE · CHAPTER 4 OF 6 · FOR THE FACILITATOR · NOT READ ALOUD
rows.ne: स्वास्थ्य कुराकानी निर्देशिका · अध्याय ६ मध्ये ४ · सहजकर्ताका लागि · ठूलो स्वरमा नपढ्ने

rows.en: What this material is about
rows.ne: यो सामग्री केका बारेमा हो

rows.en: The poster and leaflet use everyday words, so that caregivers can talk about changes in their children without clinical labels. This page gives the meaning behind those words and the limits of your role; page 4 holds the clinical terms, for reference only.
rows.ne: पोस्टर र पर्चामा दैनिक बोलचालका शब्द प्रयोग गरिएको छ, ताकि अभिभावकले क्लिनिकल नाम नदिई आफ्ना बालबालिकामा आएका परिवर्तनबारे कुरा गर्न सकून् । यो पृष्ठले ती शब्दहरूको पछाडिको अर्थ र तपाईंको भूमिकाका सीमाहरू बताउँछ; पृष्ठ ४ मा सन्दर्भका लागि मात्र क्लिनिकल शब्दहरू छन् ।

rows.en: Word key
rows.ne: शब्द कुञ्जी

rows.en: On the poster or leaflet
rows.ne: पोस्टर वा पर्चामा

rows.en: What we mean
rows.ne: हाम्रो अर्थ

rows.en: How to handle it in the talk
rows.ne: कुराकानीमा कसरी सम्हाल्ने

rows.en: “Children react too”; “Cling to you, sleep badly, cry or get angry more, become very quiet”
rows.ne: “बालबालिकामा पनि प्रतिक्रिया हुन्छ”; “तपाईंसँग टाँसिइरहने, राम्रोसँग नसुत्ने, धेरै रुने वा रिसाउने, धेरै चुप हुने”

rows.en: Common stress reactions in children, including regression (for example wetting the bed again) and changes in behaviour
rows.ne: बालबालिकामा हुने सामान्य तनाव प्रतिक्रियाहरू, पछाडि फर्किने व्यवहार (जस्तै फेरि ओछ्यानमा पिसाब फेर्ने) र व्यवहारमा परिवर्तनसमेत

rows.en: Say “changes” or “reactions”, not “problems” or “symptoms”; do not blame parents
rows.ne: “समस्या” वा “लक्षण” होइन, “परिवर्तन” वा “प्रतिक्रिया” भन्नुहोस्; अभिभावकलाई दोष नदिनुहोस्

rows.en: “Answer questions honestly, in simple words”
rows.ne: “प्रश्नको इमानदारीपूर्वक, सरल शब्दमा जवाफ दिनुहोस्”

rows.en: Age-appropriate, truthful information, including about a death or a missing relative
rows.ne: उमेर सुहाउँदो, सत्य जानकारी, मृत्यु वा बेपत्ता आफन्तबारेसमेत

rows.en: Help caregivers find simple words; do not advise hiding a death
rows.ne: अभिभावकलाई सरल शब्द खोज्न सघाउनुहोस्; मृत्यु लुकाउने सल्लाह नदिनुहोस्

rows.en: “Do not punish a child for being afraid or upset”
rows.ne: “डराएकोमा वा दुःखी भएकोमा बच्चालाई सजाय नदिनुहोस्”

rows.en: Positive, non-violent parenting; fear is not misbehaviour
rows.ne: सकारात्मक, अहिंसात्मक पालनपोषण; डर गलत व्यवहार होइन

rows.en: If a child may be at risk of harm, follow child safeguarding; do not investigate
rows.ne: कुनै बच्चा हानिको जोखिममा हुन सक्छ भने बाल सुरक्षा प्रक्रिया पालना गर्नुहोस्; अनुसन्धान नगर्नुहोस्

rows.en: Changes in children, and when to look further
rows.ne: बालबालिकामा परिवर्तन, र कहिले थप हेर्ने

rows.en: Common changes
rows.ne: सामान्य परिवर्तनहरू

rows.en: Clinging, crying more, sleeping badly, wetting the bed again, getting angry easily, being very quiet, or playing out what happened again and again. These are expected after a distressing experience.
rows.ne: टाँसिइरहने, धेरै रुने, राम्रोसँग नसुत्ने, फेरि ओछ्यानमा पिसाब फेर्ने, छिट्टै रिसाउने, धेरै चुप हुने, वा जे भयो त्यसलाई बारम्बार खेलमा दोहोर्‍याउने । पीडादायी अनुभवपछि यी अपेक्षित हुन् ।

rows.en: Early help, at any time
rows.ne: समयमै सहयोग, जुनसुकै बेला

rows.en: If changes have not improved at all about one month after the event, are getting worse, or stop the child eating, playing or learning, link the family to a health worker. Sooner if the caregiver asks.
rows.ne: घटनाको करिब एक महिनापछि पनि परिवर्तनमा कुनै सुधार नभएमा, झन् बढ्दै गएमा, वा बच्चाले खान, खेल्न वा सिक्न छाडेमा, परिवारलाई स्वास्थ्यकर्मीसँग जोड्नुहोस् । अभिभावकले माग्नुभयो भने अझ चाँडै ।

rows.en: Get help now
rows.ne: अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस्

rows.en: If a child talks about hurting themselves, or a child may be at risk of harm, follow page 2 at once.
rows.ne: कुनै बच्चाले आफूलाई हानि पुर्‍याउने कुरा गरेमा, वा कुनै बच्चा हानिको जोखिममा हुन सक्छ भने, तुरुन्तै पृष्ठ २ पालना गर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Keep these apart
rows.ne: यी कुरालाई छुट्टै राख्नुहोस्

rows.en: Common reactions are expected changes after a distressing experience, not an illness.
rows.ne: सामान्य प्रतिक्रियाहरू पीडादायी अनुभवपछिका अपेक्षित परिवर्तन हुन्, रोग होइनन् ।

rows.en: A protection concern (abuse, neglect or separation) is not a mental-health label: it goes through child safeguarding.
rows.ne: संरक्षणसम्बन्धी चिन्ता (दुर्व्यवहार, बेवास्ता वा छुट्टिनु) मानसिक स्वास्थ्यको नाम होइन: यो बाल सुरक्षा प्रक्रियामार्फत जान्छ ।

rows.en: A diagnosis describes a lasting pattern that impairs daily life, assessed by a trained health worker.
rows.ne: निदानले दैनिक जीवनमा बाधा पुर्‍याउने लामो समयसम्म रहने ढाँचा बताउँछ, जसको मूल्याङ्कन तालिम प्राप्त स्वास्थ्यकर्मीले गर्छन् ।

rows.en: Your limits
rows.ne: तपाईंका सीमाहरू

rows.en: You do not assess or diagnose a child.
rows.ne: तपाईं कुनै बच्चाको मूल्याङ्कन वा निदान गर्नुहुन्न ।

rows.en: You do not investigate abuse or neglect; you report through the child safeguarding procedure.
rows.ne: तपाईं दुर्व्यवहार वा बेवास्ताको अनुसन्धान गर्नुहुन्न; बाल सुरक्षा (safeguarding) प्रक्रियामार्फत जानकारी दिनुहुन्छ ।

rows.en: You do not promise schooling, support or services you cannot confirm.
rows.ne: तपाईं पुष्टि गर्न नसकिने विद्यालय, सहयोग वा सेवाको वाचा गर्नुहुन्न ।

rows.en: Your role
rows.ne: तपाईंको भूमिका

rows.en: This guide supports a session; it does not replace psychological first aid training. Use your training, supervisor and known referral routes, including child protection.
rows.ne: यो निर्देशिकाले सत्र सञ्चालनमा सहयोग गर्छ; यसले मनोवैज्ञानिक प्राथमिक उपचारको तालिमको ठाउँ लिँदैन । आफ्नो तालिम, सुपरिवेक्षक र बाल संरक्षणसहित थाहा भएका प्रेषणका बाटो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Look after yourself too: take breaks, talk with your supervisor or a colleague, and ask for support when you need it.
rows.ne: आफ्नो पनि ख्याल राख्नुहोस्: विश्राम लिनुहोस्, आफ्ना सुपरिवेक्षक वा सहकर्मीसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस्, र चाहिएको बेला सहयोग माग्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Talking privately with a caregiver
rows.ne: अभिभावकसँग निजी रूपमा कुरा गर्दा

rows.en: Introduce yourself and ask permission. Explain what you can and cannot offer.
rows.ne: आफ्नो परिचय दिनुहोस् र अनुमति लिनुहोस् । तपाईं के दिन सक्नुहुन्छ र के सक्नुहुन्न भनेर बताउनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Listen to their worries without judging; they know their child best.
rows.ne: मूल्याङ्कन नगरी उहाँका चिन्ता सुन्नुहोस्; आफ्नो बच्चालाई उहाँ नै राम्रोसँग चिन्नुहुन्छ ।

rows.en: Help them choose one thing to try this week, from the leaflet.
rows.ne: यो हप्ता प्रयास गर्न पर्चाबाट एउटा कुरा छान्न सघाउनुहोस् ।

rows.en: If they say they cannot cope or are afraid of hurting the child, take it seriously and link them to further help (page 2).
rows.ne: उहाँले आफूले सम्हाल्न नसकेको वा बच्चालाई हानि पुर्‍याइहाल्छु कि भन्ने डर भएको बताउनुभयो भने यसलाई गम्भीर रूपमा लिनुहोस् र थप सहयोगसँग जोड्नुहोस् (पृष्ठ २) ।

rows.en: Agree any follow-up only if it is possible and wanted; do not promise a visit or call you cannot make.
rows.ne: सम्भव र चाहिएको भए मात्र पछिको भेटघाट तय गर्नुहोस्; गर्न नसक्ने भेट वा फोनको वाचा नगर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Sources: WHO and UNICEF, Helping children cope with stress (2020); WHO, Psychological First Aid: Guide for Field Workers (2011); WHO/UNHCR, mhGAP Humanitarian Intervention Guide (2015); WHO, mhGAP module: Assessment and management of conditions specifically related to stress (2013); IASC, Guidelines on MHPSS in Emergency Settings (2007).
rows.ne: स्रोतहरू: WHO and UNICEF, Helping children cope with stress (2020); WHO, Psychological First Aid: Guide for Field Workers (2011); WHO/UNHCR, mhGAP Humanitarian Intervention Guide (2015); WHO, mhGAP module: Assessment and management of conditions specifically related to stress (2013); IASC, Guidelines on MHPSS in Emergency Settings (2007) ।

rows.en: HEALTH TALK GUIDE · CHAPTER 4 OF 6 · FACILITATOR REFERENCE · FOR REFERENCE ONLY
rows.ne: स्वास्थ्य कुराकानी निर्देशिका · अध्याय ६ मध्ये ४ · सहजकर्ताका लागि सन्दर्भ · सन्दर्भका लागि मात्र

rows.en: Clinical terms you may hear
rows.ne: तपाईंले सुन्न सक्ने क्लिनिकल शब्दहरू

rows.en: For reference only. Do not use these terms with caregivers, and do not diagnose. They help you understand what a health worker may say, and why early help does not have to wait.
rows.ne: सन्दर्भका लागि मात्र । यी शब्द अभिभावकसँग प्रयोग नगर्नुहोस्, र निदान नगर्नुहोस् । स्वास्थ्यकर्मीले के भन्न सक्छन्, र समयमै सहयोगका लागि किन पर्खनु पर्दैन भनेर बुझ्न यसले सघाउँछ ।

rows.en: Term or situation
rows.ne: शब्द वा अवस्था

rows.en: What the facilitator needs to know
rows.ne: सहजकर्ताले जान्नुपर्ने कुरा

rows.en: Source
rows.ne: स्रोत

rows.en: Common reactions in children
rows.ne: बालबालिकामा हुने सामान्य प्रतिक्रियाहरू

rows.en: Clinging, crying, sleep problems, wetting the bed again, irritability, withdrawal, or playing out the event. Expected after a distressing experience.
rows.ne: टाँसिइरहने, रुने, निद्राका समस्या, फेरि ओछ्यानमा पिसाब फेर्ने, झर्को लाग्ने, अलग्गिने, वा घटनालाई खेलमा दोहोर्‍याउने । पीडादायी अनुभवपछि अपेक्षित ।

rows.en: WHO and UNICEF, Helping children cope with stress (2020)
rows.ne: WHO and UNICEF, Helping children cope with stress (2020)
rows.note: Kept in English (title, code or source)

rows.en: When to look further
rows.ne: कहिले थप हेर्ने

rows.en: Changes that have not improved at all about one month after the event, are getting worse, or stop the child eating, playing or learning: link to a health worker. A child who talks about hurting themselves: urgent help.
rows.ne: घटनाको करिब एक महिनापछि पनि कुनै सुधार नभएका, झन् बढ्दै गएका, वा बच्चालाई खान, खेल्न वा सिक्नबाट रोक्ने परिवर्तन: स्वास्थ्यकर्मीसँग जोड्नुहोस् । आफूलाई हानि पुर्‍याउने कुरा गर्ने बच्चा: तत्काल सहयोग ।

rows.en: WHO mhGAP stress module (2013)
rows.ne: WHO mhGAP stress module (2013)
rows.note: Kept in English (title, code or source)

rows.en: Post-traumatic stress in children
rows.ne: बालबालिकामा आघातपछिको तनाव (post-traumatic stress)

rows.en: Can occur in children; the criteria for children aged six and younger differ from those for older children and adults. Assessed only by a trained health worker.
rows.ne: बालबालिकामा पनि हुन सक्छ; छ वर्ष र सोभन्दा कम उमेरका बालबालिकाका मापदण्ड ठूला बालबालिका र वयस्कका भन्दा फरक हुन्छन् । तालिम प्राप्त स्वास्थ्यकर्मीले मात्र मूल्याङ्कन गर्छन् ।

rows.en: American Psychiatric Association, DSM-5-TR (2022)
rows.ne: American Psychiatric Association, DSM-5-TR (2022)
rows.note: Kept in English (title, code or source)

rows.en: Child protection
rows.ne: बाल संरक्षण

rows.en: Any concern of abuse, neglect or separation is a protection matter, not a mental-health label: follow child safeguarding and contact the child protection focal point.
rows.ne: दुर्व्यवहार, बेवास्ता वा छुट्टिनेसम्बन्धी कुनै पनि चिन्ता संरक्षणको विषय हो, मानसिक स्वास्थ्यको नाम होइन: बाल सुरक्षा प्रक्रिया पालना गर्नुहोस् र बाल संरक्षण सम्पर्क व्यक्तिलाई सम्पर्क गर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: IASC, Guidelines on MHPSS in Emergency Settings (2007)
rows.ne: IASC, Guidelines on MHPSS in Emergency Settings (2007)
rows.note: Kept in English (title, code or source)

rows.en: “Trauma”, when a caregiver uses the word
rows.ne: “ट्रमा”, अभिभावकले यो शब्द प्रयोग गर्दा

rows.en: Do not correct the word and do not start a discussion about trauma. Ask what the caregiver means and what the child does: “When you say traumatised, what do you notice in your child?” Caregivers often use the word for a specific change, for example a child who will not let them out of sight, or who is afraid of loud noises at night. Such changes are common reactions after a frightening or potentially traumatic experience. Respond to what the caregiver describes, and use the early-help route if it continues, gets worse or makes daily life hard.
rows.ne: शब्द नसच्याउनुहोस् र ट्रमाबारे छलफल सुरु नगर्नुहोस् । अभिभावकको अर्थ के हो र बच्चाले के गर्छ भनेर सोध्नुहोस्: “तपाईंले ट्रमा भन्नुहुँदा आफ्नो बच्चामा के देख्नुहुन्छ?” अभिभावकले प्रायः यो शब्द कुनै खास परिवर्तनका लागि प्रयोग गर्छन्, जस्तै आफूलाई आँखाबाट ओझेल हुन नदिने, वा रातमा ठूला आवाजसँग डराउने बच्चा । यस्ता परिवर्तन डरलाग्दो वा आघात पुर्‍याउन सक्ने अनुभवपछिका सामान्य प्रतिक्रिया हुन् । अभिभावकले बताएको कुरामा प्रतिक्रिया दिनुहोस्, र यो लामो समय रहिरहे, झन् बढे वा दैनिक जीवन कठिन बनाए समयमै सहयोगको बाटो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Facilitation practice for this series; listening as in WHO, Psychological First Aid (2011)
rows.ne: यो शृङ्खलाको सहजीकरण अभ्यास; सुन्ने तरिका WHO, Psychological First Aid (2011) अनुसार

rows.en: HEALTH TALK GUIDE · CHAPTER 4 OF 6 · PRACTICE CARDS · FOR THE FACILITATOR
rows.ne: स्वास्थ्य कुराकानी निर्देशिका · अध्याय ६ मध्ये ४ · अभ्यास कार्डहरू · सहजकर्ताका लागि

rows.en: Practice cards
rows.ne: अभ्यास कार्डहरू

rows.en: Examples of what people may say and what you can do, step by step. They take place in a private conversation, not in front of the group. The words are an illustration: use your own, follow the person’s lead, and use page 2 at once if there is any urgent sign.
rows.ne: मानिसहरूले के भन्न सक्छन् र तपाईं चरणबद्ध रूपमा के गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ भन्ने उदाहरणहरू । यी कुराकानी समूहका अगाडि होइन, निजी रूपमा हुन्छन् । शब्दहरू उदाहरण मात्र हुन्: आफ्नै शब्द प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, व्यक्तिको इच्छाअनुसार अघि बढ्नुहोस्, र कुनै तत्काल संकेत देखिएमा तुरुन्तै पृष्ठ २ प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Words for you to say or ask
rows.ne: तपाईंले भन्ने वा सोध्ने शब्दहरू

rows.en: What the person may say
rows.ne: व्यक्तिले भन्न सक्ने कुरा

rows.en: Guidance for you (plain text)
rows.ne: तपाईंका लागि निर्देशन (सादा अक्षर)

rows.en: WHEN A CAREGIVER SAYS “TRAUMA”
rows.ne: अभिभावकले “ट्रमा” भनेमा

rows.en: “My daughter is traumatised. She will not let me out of her sight.”
rows.ne: “मेरी छोरीलाई ट्रमा भएको छ । उसले मलाई आँखाबाट ओझेल हुनै दिँदैन ।”

rows.en: Poster: children may cling to you.
rows.ne: पोस्टर: बालबालिका तपाईंसँग टाँसिइरहन सक्छन् ।

rows.en: Ask what they mean
rows.ne: उहाँको अर्थ सोध्नुहोस्

rows.en: “When you say traumatised, what do you notice in her?”
rows.ne: “तपाईंले ट्रमा भन्नुहुँदा उसमा के देख्नुहुन्छ?”

rows.en: THEY SAY
rows.ne: उहाँ भन्नुहुन्छ

rows.en: “She cries when I go to the queue for food. At night she holds my hand until she sleeps.”
rows.ne: “म खानाको लाइनमा जाँदा ऊ रुन्छे । रातमा मेरो हात समातेर मात्र सुत्छे ।”

rows.en: Name it as common
rows.ne: यसलाई सामान्य भनेर बुझाउनुहोस्

rows.en: “Many children cling to their parents after a frightening time. It shows she feels safest with you.”
rows.ne: “डरलाग्दो समयपछि धेरै बालबालिका आमाबुबासँग टाँसिइरहन्छन् । यसले ऊ तपाईंसँग सबैभन्दा सुरक्षित महसुस गर्छे भन्ने देखाउँछ ।”

rows.en: Agree one thing to try
rows.ne: प्रयास गर्ने एउटा कुरा तय गर्नुहोस्

rows.en: Suggest telling her where you are going and when you will be back, and keeping regular times for meals and sleep, as on the leaflet.
rows.ne: पर्चामा जस्तै, आफू कहाँ जाँदै हुनुहुन्छ र कहिले फर्कनुहुन्छ भनेर उसलाई बताउने, र खाने र सुत्ने समय नियमित राख्ने सुझाव दिनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Know when to look further
rows.ne: कहिले थप हेर्ने भनेर जान्नुहोस्

rows.en: If there is no improvement at all about one month after the event, or it gets worse, or she stops eating, playing or talking, link to a health worker (page 3). Sooner if the caregiver asks.
rows.ne: घटनाको करिब एक महिनापछि पनि कुनै सुधार नभएमा, झन् बढेमा, वा उसले खान, खेल्न वा बोल्न छाडेमा, स्वास्थ्यकर्मीसँग जोड्नुहोस् (पृष्ठ ३) । अभिभावकले माग्नुभयो भने अझ चाँडै ।

rows.en: WHEN A CHILD WETS THE BED AGAIN
rows.ne: बच्चाले फेरि ओछ्यानमा पिसाब फेर्दा

rows.en: “He is eight and he wets the bed again. I shouted at him this morning.”
rows.ne: “ऊ आठ वर्षको भयो, फेरि ओछ्यानमा पिसाब फेर्छ । आज बिहान मैले उसलाई कराएँ ।”

rows.en: Poster: do not punish a child for being afraid or upset.
rows.ne: पोस्टर: डराएकोमा वा दुःखी भएकोमा बच्चालाई सजाय नदिनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Listen without blaming
rows.ne: दोष नदिई सुन्नुहोस्

rows.en: Thank the caregiver for telling you. Do not blame them or the child.
rows.ne: बताउनुभएकोमा अभिभावकलाई धन्यवाद दिनुहोस् । उहाँलाई वा बच्चालाई दोष नदिनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Explain
rows.ne: बुझाउनुहोस्

rows.en: “Wetting the bed again can happen after a distressing experience. It is not naughtiness, and it is not your fault.”
rows.ne: “पीडादायी अनुभवपछि फेरि ओछ्यानमा पिसाब फेर्ने हुन सक्छ । यो बदमासी होइन, र यो तपाईंको गल्ती पनि होइन ।”

rows.en: Agree a calm response
rows.ne: शान्त प्रतिक्रिया तय गर्नुहोस्

rows.en: No punishment or teasing; give extra time and affection, as on the leaflet. If the child has pain or fever, or seems unwell, link to a health worker.
rows.ne: सजाय वा जिस्काउनु हुँदैन; पर्चामा जस्तै थप समय र माया दिनुहोस् । बच्चालाई दुखाइ वा ज्वरो छ, वा बिरामी देखिन्छ भने स्वास्थ्यकर्मीसँग जोड्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: WHEN A CAREGIVER CANNOT COPE
rows.ne: अभिभावकले सम्हाल्न नसक्दा

rows.en: “I have no patience left. Sometimes I am so angry I want to hit him.”
rows.ne: “मसँग धैर्य बाँकी छैन । कहिलेकाहीँ यति रिस उठ्छ कि उसलाई कुटूँ जस्तो लाग्छ ।”

rows.en: Leaflet: look after yourself too.
rows.ne: पर्चा: आफ्नो पनि ख्याल राख्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Listen, then ask about safety
rows.ne: सुन्नुहोस्, अनि सुरक्षाबारे सोध्नुहोस्

rows.en: Thank them for saying it, without judging.
rows.ne: मूल्याङ्कन नगरी, बताउनुभएकोमा धन्यवाद दिनुहोस् ।

rows.en: “Has anyone been hurt? Are you afraid you might hurt him?”
rows.ne: “कसैलाई चोट लागेको छ? तपाईंलाई उसलाई हानि पुर्‍याइहाल्छु कि भन्ने डर लाग्छ?”

rows.en: If a child may be at risk of harm, follow your child safeguarding procedure (page 2). Do not investigate yourself.
rows.ne: कुनै बच्चा हानिको जोखिममा हुन सक्छ भने आफ्नो बाल सुरक्षा (safeguarding) प्रक्रिया पालना गर्नुहोस् (पृष्ठ २) । आफैं अनुसन्धान नगर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Offer a pause
rows.ne: एकछिन रोकिने सुझाव दिनुहोस्

rows.en: “When anger comes, take a short pause: breathe, then respond.”
rows.ne: “रिस उठ्दा एकछिन रोकिनुहोस्: सास फेर्नुहोस्, अनि मात्र प्रतिक्रिया दिनुहोस् ।”

rows.en: Share the load and link
rows.ne: भार बाँड्नुहोस् र जोड्नुहोस्

rows.en: Help them think who could share care, such as family or neighbours. A caregiver who says they cannot cope is a reason to link to further help (page 2).
rows.ne: परिवार वा छिमेकीजस्ता कसले हेरचाहमा हात बटाउन सक्छन् भनेर सोच्न सघाउनुहोस् । आफूले सम्हाल्न नसकेको बताउने अभिभावक थप सहयोगसँग जोड्ने कारण हो (पृष्ठ २) ।

rows.en: AFTER A DISTRESSING EXPERIENCE
rows.ne: पीडादायी अनुभवपछि
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): After a distressing/painful experience.

rows.en: Every family's next step is different
rows.ne: हरेक परिवारको अर्को कदम फरक हुन्छ

rows.en: Home is more than a house. Adjusting can take time.
rows.ne: घर भनेको भवन मात्र होइन । नयाँ अवस्थामा बानी पर्न समय लाग्न सक्छ ।

rows.en: Going home
rows.ne: घर फर्कंदै

rows.en: Moving somewhere new
rows.ne: नयाँ ठाउँमा सर्दै

rows.en: Return only when it is safe.
rows.ne: सुरक्षित भएपछि मात्र फर्कनुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Return only after it is safe.

rows.en: Give yourself time to settle.
rows.ne: नयाँ ठाउँमा भिज्न आफूलाई समय दिनुहोस् ।

rows.en: What can help
rows.ne: केले सहयोग गर्न सक्छ

rows.en: Still waiting
rows.ne: अझै पर्खिँदै

rows.en: Stay close to people you trust
rows.ne: आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिसको नजिक रहनुहोस्

rows.en: Ask for updates.
rows.ne: पछिल्लो जानकारी सोध्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Keep routines for children
rows.ne: बालबालिकाको दिनचर्या कायम राख्नुहोस्

rows.en: Ask for checked information
rows.ne: पुष्टि भएको जानकारी सोध्नुहोस्

rows.en: Know a safer place. Act on warnings straight away.
rows.ne: अझ सुरक्षित ठाउँ थाहा पाउनुहोस् । चेतावनी आएमा तुरुन्तै त्यसअनुसार कदम चाल्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Know a safer place. If a warning comes, act accordingly immediately.

rows.en: Ask for help early
rows.ne: समयमै सहयोग माग्नुहोस्
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Ask for help in time.

rows.en: Feelings getting worse, not going away, or making daily life hard? Talk to a health worker. You do not have to wait.
rows.ne: के तपाईंका भावना झन् गाह्रा हुँदैछन्, हटिरहेका छैनन्, वा दैनिक जीवन कठिन बनाइरहेका छन्? स्वास्थ्यकर्मीसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस् । तपाईंले पर्खनुपर्दैन ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Are your feelings becoming more difficult, not going away, or making daily life difficult? Talk to a health worker. You do not have to wait.

rows.en: Get help now
rows.ne: अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस्
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Get help right now.

rows.en: In danger, or thinking of harming yourself? Get help now. Ask a health worker or responder, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.
rows.ne: के तपाईं खतरामा हुनुहुन्छ, वा आफूलाई हानि पुर्‍याउने सोच आइरहेको छ? अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस् । स्वास्थ्यकर्मी वा उद्धारकर्मीलाई सहयोग माग्नुहोस्, र आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिसलाई तपाईंसँगै बस्न भन्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Are you in danger, or having thoughts of harming yourself? Get help right now. Ask a health worker or rescue worker for help, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.

rows.en: Help near you: ____________ (filled in and checked locally)
rows.ne: तपाईं नजिकैको सहयोग: ____________ (स्थानीय रूपमा भरेर जाँच गरिएको)
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Help near you: ____________ (filled and checked locally).

rows.en: Support is for everyone, including people with disabilities and older people. Ask for large print or more time.
rows.ne: सहयोग सबैका लागि हो, अपाङ्गता भएका व्यक्ति र ज्येष्ठ नागरिकका लागि पनि । ठूला अक्षर वा थप समय माग्न सक्नुहुन्छ ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Support is for everyone, including persons with disabilities and older citizens. You may ask for large letters or more time.

rows.en: Look after yourself. Look after each other.
rows.ne: आफ्नो ख्याल राख्नुहोस् । एकअर्काको ख्याल राख्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Fictional illustrations, AI-assisted and developed under human direction.
rows.ne: काल्पनिक चित्रहरू, मानवीय निर्देशनमा AI को सहायताले तयार गरिएका ।

rows.en: Community wall poster · A3 · Chapter 5 of 6 · English review draft · Not for field distribution.
rows.ne: सामुदायिक भित्ते पोस्टर · A3 · अध्याय ६ मध्ये ५ · नेपाली समीक्षा मस्यौदा · क्षेत्रमा वितरणका लागि होइन ।

ch5.title: Chapter 5 · Every family's next step is different · Leaflet A4 tri-fold
ch5.source: Approved English leaflet r3 (exact text of the online and print versions) · Nepali machine draft r1, 14 Nov 2026, language and MHPSS review pending; every row needs a native reviewer

rows.en: AFTER A DISTRESSING EXPERIENCE
rows.ne: पीडादायी अनुभवपछि
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): After a distressing/painful experience.

rows.en: Every family’s next step is different
rows.ne: हरेक परिवारको अर्को कदम फरक हुन्छ
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): None

rows.en: Some families are going home, some are moving somewhere new, and some are still waiting. You may feel relief, sadness, worry or anger, sometimes all at once. Even a familiar place may not feel the same.
rows.ne: केही परिवार घर फर्कंदैछन्, केही नयाँ ठाउँमा सर्दैछन्, र केही अझै पर्खिरहेका छन् । तपाईंलाई राहत, दुःख, चिन्ता वा रिस, कहिलेकाहीँ सबै एकैपटक, महसुस हुन सक्छ । परिचित ठाउँ पनि पहिलेजस्तो नलाग्न सक्छ ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Going home
rows.ne: घर फर्कंदै
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): None

rows.en: Before entering a damaged home, ask your ward office how to get a safety check of the house and land. If you are not sure it is safe, do not go in. Go with someone you trust, if you can.
rows.ne: क्षतिग्रस्त घरभित्र पस्नुअघि, घर र जग्गाको सुरक्षा जाँच कसरी गराउने भनेर आफ्नो वडा कार्यालयलाई सोध्नुहोस् । सुरक्षित छ कि छैन भन्ने निश्चित नभए भित्र नपस्नुहोस् । सकेसम्म आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिससँगै जानुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Before entering a damaged house, ask your ward office how to get a safety check of house and land. If not sure whether it is safe, do not go inside. If possible go together with a person you trust.

rows.en: Moving somewhere new
rows.ne: नयाँ ठाउँमा सर्दै
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): None

rows.en: You may miss your old home, even in a safe new place. Give yourself time. If it feels right, talk with the people you stay with about sharing space and daily tasks.
rows.ne: सुरक्षित नयाँ ठाउँमा पनि तपाईंलाई पुरानो घरको याद आउन सक्छ । आफूलाई समय दिनुहोस् । ठीक लागे, सँगै बस्ने मानिससँग ठाउँ र दैनिक काम बाँडफाँट गर्नेबारे कुरा गर्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Still waiting
rows.ne: अझै पर्खिँदै
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): None

rows.en: Not knowing what comes next is hard. Ask the person in charge of your shelter, or your ward office:
rows.ne: अब के हुन्छ भन्ने थाहा नहुनु गाह्रो हुन्छ । आफ्नो आश्रयस्थलको जिम्मेवार व्यक्ति वा वडा कार्यालयलाई सोध्नुहोस्:
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Not knowing what happens now is hard. Ask the responsible person of your shelter or the ward office:

rows.en: What is known?
rows.ne: के थाहा भइसकेको छ?
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): What is already known?

rows.en: What is not decided yet?
rows.ne: के अझै निर्णय भएको छैन?
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): What has not yet been decided?

rows.en: When can I ask again?
rows.ne: म फेरि कहिले सोध्न सक्छु?
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): When can I ask again?

rows.en: You do not have to manage alone
rows.ne: तपाईंले एक्लै सबै सम्हाल्नुपर्दैन
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Choose what is possible for you today. If you need food, safe water, medicines or a place to stay, ask a worker to help you find support. If your medicines are lost or running out, ask a health worker how to continue them safely.
rows.ne: आज आफूले गर्न सक्ने कुरा छान्नुहोस् । खाना, सुरक्षित पानी, औषधि वा बस्ने ठाउँ चाहिएमा, सहयोग खोज्न कुनै कार्यकर्तालाई मद्दत माग्नुहोस् । तपाईंको औषधि हराएको वा सकिन लागेको छ भने, त्यसलाई सुरक्षित रूपमा कसरी निरन्तर राख्ने भनेर स्वास्थ्यकर्मीलाई सोध्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Choose what you can do today. If you need food, safe water, medicine or a place to stay, ask a worker for help to find support. If your medicine is lost or running out, ask a health worker how to continue it safely.

rows.en: Wherever you are staying
rows.ne: तपाईं जहाँ बसे पनि
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Home is more than a building
rows.ne: घर भनेको भवन मात्र होइन
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: You may miss neighbours, work, familiar places and memories. These losses matter. Spend time with someone you trust, if you wish.
rows.ne: तपाईंलाई छिमेकी, काम, परिचित ठाउँ र सम्झनाहरूको याद आउन सक्छ । यी कुरा गुमाउनु सानो कुरा होइन । चाहनुहुन्छ भने आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिससँग समय बिताउनुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Worried when it rains?
rows.ne: पानी पर्दा चिन्ता लाग्छ?
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Ask local responders about warnings and a safer place to go. If a warning comes, act on it straight away.
rows.ne: चेतावनी र जान सकिने सुरक्षित ठाउँबारे स्थानीय उद्धारकर्मीलाई सोध्नुहोस् । चेतावनी आएमा तुरुन्तै त्यसअनुसार गर्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Ask local responders about warnings and a safe place to go. If a warning comes, act on it immediately.

rows.en: Worried about money or work?
rows.ne: पैसा वा कामको चिन्ता छ?
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Ask your ward office what help you can apply for, what you need, and who can help you apply. Take someone you trust if it helps.
rows.ne: कुन सहयोगका लागि आवेदन दिन सकिन्छ, के-के चाहिन्छ, र आवेदन दिन कसले सघाउन सक्छ भनेर आफ्नो वडा कार्यालयमा सोध्नुहोस् । सजिलो हुन्छ भने आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिसलाई साथमा लैजानुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Make time for children
rows.ne: बालबालिकाका लागि समय निकाल्नुहोस्
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Tell them what you know, and say when you do not know. Keep safe play and familiar routines. Do not punish children for being frightened or upset.
rows.ne: आफूलाई थाहा भएका कुरा बताउनुहोस्, र थाहा नभएको कुरा थाहा छैन भनेर भन्नुहोस् । सुरक्षित खेल र परिचित दिनचर्या कायम राख्नुहोस् । डराएकोमा वा दुःखी भएकोमा बालबालिकालाई सजाय नदिनुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine):

rows.en: Ask for help early
rows.ne: समयमै सहयोग माग्नुहोस्
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Ask for help in time.

rows.en: Feelings getting worse, not going away, or making daily life hard? Talk to a health worker. You do not have to wait.
rows.ne: के तपाईंका भावना झन् गाह्रा हुँदैछन्, हटिरहेका छैनन्, वा दैनिक जीवन कठिन बनाइरहेका छन्? स्वास्थ्यकर्मीसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस् । तपाईंले पर्खनुपर्दैन ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Are your feelings becoming more difficult, not going away, or making daily life difficult? Talk to a health worker. You do not have to wait.

rows.en: Get help now
rows.ne: अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस्
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Get help right now.

rows.en: In danger, or thinking of harming yourself? Get help now. Ask a health worker or responder, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.
rows.ne: के तपाईं खतरामा हुनुहुन्छ, वा आफूलाई हानि पुर्‍याउने सोच आइरहेको छ? अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस् । स्वास्थ्यकर्मी वा उद्धारकर्मीलाई सहयोग माग्नुहोस्, र आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिसलाई तपाईंसँगै बस्न भन्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Are you in danger, or having thoughts of harming yourself? Get help right now. Ask a health worker or rescue worker for help, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.

rows.en: Help near you:
rows.ne: तपाईं नजिकैको सहयोग:
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Help near you:

rows.en: ____________ (filled in and checked locally)
rows.ne: ____________ (स्थानीय रूपमा भरेर जाँच गरिएको)
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): ____ (filled in and checked locally)

rows.en: Look after yourself. Look after each other.
rows.ne: आफ्नो ख्याल राख्नुहोस् । एकअर्काको ख्याल राख्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): None

rows.en: Support is for everyone, including people with disabilities and older people. Ask for large print or more time.
rows.ne: सहयोग सबैका लागि हो, अपाङ्गता भएका व्यक्ति र ज्येष्ठ नागरिकका लागि पनि । ठूला अक्षर वा थप समय माग्न सक्नुहुन्छ ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Support is for everyone, including persons with disabilities and older citizens. You may ask for large letters or more time.
